subject: general
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 6 2 7 2 6 4 8 4 7 4 3 3 4 2 6 7 1 9 7 4 7 9 1 6 5 8 5 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 6 2 7 2 6 4 8 4 7 4 3 3 4 2 6 7 1 9 7 4 7 9 1 6 5 8 5 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e2d9e9b611c8d2bfed15c57200bc58d269882d7d2a9ddcab9125123be81c8b5.png] 

Thus, there are 2 even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
